messages:
rachel: spinning up zephyr-lite-6b v1.2 int4 canary. encountering intermittent OOMs when requests go beyond ~280 tokens. also noticing p95 latency spikes. anyone free to triage?

simon: saw a drop in throughput yesterday on dedicated pools for this model. suspected KV prefetch/slot interactions. logs?

rachel: paste config below:
```
model: zephyr-lite-6b-v1.2-int4
batch_size: 12
max_new_tokens: 768
prefetch_kv: true
kv_prefetch_slots: 36
slot_eviction: eager
session_cache: enabled
```

rachel: sample log: `Worker-7 OOM allocate(512MB) live=12.1GB free=0.2GB epoch=435`

priya: 36 slots + batch12 is a lot for int4 allocator fragmentation. try batch=6 + kv_prefetch_slots=18 to see if mem stabilizes. also set `slot_eviction: lazy` to reduce concurrent evictions.

tom: quick repro plan: 1) perf with batch6/slots18/max_new=384, 2) compare cuda_mem_snapshot, 3) run 50-case quality check vs float. I'll stand by for traces.

ops-bot: canary deploy started for zephyr-lite-6b-v1.2-int4 (canary=5).

simon: note: there was a previous allocator bug where int4 allocations didn't combine small free spans, causing fragmentation on sustained workloads. might be related.

rachel: running perf (batch6/slots18/max_new 384) now. will post numbers in ~10m.

ops-bot: perf run complete: p50=180ms p95=460ms tokens/s/GPU=920 no OOM in first 500 calls. cuda_mem_snapshot: /artifacts/zephyr/4600012345/mem1.json

priya: good, that suggests fragmentation-pressure threshold around original config. can you run one with batch12 but `prefetch_kv=false` to check if prefetch concurrency is the main culprit?

simon: also try `max_new_tokens=256` as a temporary hosted default for this model to avoid tail allocation spikes. We can relax later.

rachel: ran batch12 + prefetch_kv=false + max_new 512. result: sporadic slow requests but still one OOM after ~900 calls. allocator_trace attached: /artifacts/zephyr/4600012345/alloc_trace_1.log

priya: allocator_trace shows many small free segments around 8-64KB and repeated allocation churn near the attention KV pages. this fits an inability to coalesce free blocks due to alignment differences introduced by int4 packing.

tom: mitigation options:
- reduce batch_size default to 8 for int4 canary
- lower hosted default max_new_tokens to 256 for zephyr-lite-int4 temporarily
- patch allocator to try cross-alignment coalescing (risky for canary timeframe)
- implement soft prefetch throttle to limit concurrent KV page loads

simon: for quality: priya, can you run a small eval (100 docs) comparing int4->fp32 logits divergence? if quant shift causes earlier stop tokens we should see distribution changes.

priya: running eval now. initial: ROUGE-L delta -1.1, but 12% of samples show earlier stop token (truncate) vs fp32. saving examples to https://ci.redwood/zephyr/qual/4600012345

rachel: action item immediate: reduce hosted default max_new_tokens to 256 for zephyr-lite-6b-int4 and set deployment soft cap for canary to batch_size=8. I'll file rollout PR.

ops-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/rollouts/PR-8291 by rachel. includes smoke tests and telemetry flag `zephyr.lite.int4.max_new_tokens=256`.

simon: medium-term: priya + infra should attempt allocator patch in a gated branch and run long-running soak for fragmentation. we can also try per-channel quantization vs global to test alignment effects.

priya: per-channel quant run queued; also enqueue symmetric vs asymmetric scale experiment. will log logits divergence and token end-rate. ETA 6h.

tom: ops note: if we lower hosted default, ensure dedicated pinned configs are respected; document in release notes.

rachel: will monitor canary for 24h and post results. thanks all. closing thread once stable. :white_check_mark:
